## Identity

Domo Cafe is an immersive character cafe in Buena Park, California. Come hungry, leave smiling.
Buena Park's character cafe.
Japanese-inspired comfort food, Domo-sized joy, and a place to make your next favorite memory.

## FAQ

### Do you take walk-ins?

Yes! Walk-ins are welcome. On busy weekends, arriving early is your best bet. For large groups (8+), call ahead at (415) 360-3666 so we can ready a table.

### Is there parking?

Yes, free parking is available in the large Buena Park Downtown lot.

### Can I celebrate a birthday here?

Absolutely — we love birthdays. For celebrations with more than 8 guests, we offer birthday packages. Call us at (415) 360-3666 or email info@domokuncafe.com and we’ll set you up.

### Do you deliver?

Yes — order online for pickup or delivery through Toast. You can also visit us in Buena Park or call (415) 360-3666.

### Where can I follow updates?

Follow us on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook for announcements and seasonal news.

## Order

## The Domo way

- Make an entrance: Every detail is an invitation to step out of the everyday.
- Lead with warmth: Good food is the start. Feeling welcome is the main event.
- Create moments: Birthdays, first dates, family days—we're saving a table for you.
- Keep it character: A little goofy, a lot genuine, and always unmistakably Domo.
